2026-11-19 05:13:49 JST [akira/akira/849a8348e5794d4783596384ea09800e] 30:Today, we are introducing Qwen4-Max, your new AI teammate for work, creativity, and discovery. Qwen4-Max is built on the new Qwen4 architecture, with a 2.4-trillion-parameter backbone, native vision capabilities, and a one-million-token context window.
2026-11-19 05:13:49 JST [akira/akira/849a8348e5794d4783596384ea09800e] 32:Qwen4-Max advances real-world productivity through greater proficiency with professional tools, stronger long-horizon task execution, and higher-quality deliverables. It can take on a wide range of creative and professional work, spanning 3D modeling, game development, precision manufacturing, finance, law, healthcare, and frontier scientific discovery. As a 24/7 AI teammate, Qwen4-Max keeps the big picture in view and moves projects forward, bringing ambitious ideas closer to reality and opening new ways for people and AI to work together.
2026-11-19 05:13:49 JST [akira/akira/849a8348e5794d4783596384ea09800e] 38:**Token efficiency and cost.** Qwen4-Max outperforms Qwen3.8-Max with fewer tokens: on [Work360](https://qwen.ai/blog?id=qwen4-max#work360), token usage drops by approximately **24%** and **35%** at Xhigh and High effort, respectively; on Terminal-Bench 4.0, the reductions are approximately **48%** and **49%**, respectively. We have also lowered API prices compared with Qwen3.8-Max, with particularly large reductions in cached-input pricing. In our Work360 evaluation, the average cost per task drops from $4.43 to $1.67 — a **62%** reduction.
2026-11-19 05:13:49 JST [akira/akira/849a8348e5794d4783596384ea09800e] 40:![Token efficiency on Work360 and Terminal-Bench 4.0.](https://img.alicdn.com/imgextra/i1/O1CN010VgwbmS9yHH6DCXk_!!6000000004985-2-tps-3060-1440.png)
2026-11-19 05:13:49 JST [akira/akira/849a8348e5794d4783596384ea09800e] 44:Qwen4-Max is built on a **new architecture for the Qwen4 series**, with **2.4T backbone parameters, 71B activated per token, and an additional 328B N-gram Embedding parameters**. The architecture systematically upgrades the sparse MoE model across **attention, residual connections, and embeddings**, improving computational efficiency, model capacity, and training stability:
2026-11-19 05:13:49 JST [akira/akira/849a8348e5794d4783596384ea09800e] 46:- **GDN + Qwen Sparse Attention (QSA):** Three Gated DeltaNet layers compress history into fixed-size states for every QSA layer. QSA uses a lightweight indexer to select relevant context at micro-block granularity, reducing both attention and indexing costs for long sequences.
2026-11-19 05:13:49 JST [akira/akira/849a8348e5794d4783596384ea09800e] 47:- **Gated Residual (GR):** Four parallel residual branches use dynamic read and write gates to strengthen information flow across layers and improve training stability.
2026-11-19 05:13:49 JST [akira/akira/849a8348e5794d4783596384ea09800e] 48:- **N-gram Embedding:** Context-based lookups provide representations of local token patterns at the second layer, expanding model capacity with little additional computation.
2026-11-19 05:13:49 JST [akira/akira/849a8348e5794d4783596384ea09800e] 50:![Qwen4-Max architecture with GDN and QSA layers, four Gated Residual branches, and N-gram Embedding.](https://qianwen-res.oss-cn-beijing.aliyuncs.com/Qwen4-Max/architecture.png#center)

2026-11-19 05:13:49 JST [akira/akira/849a8348e5794d4783596384ea09800e] 473:**Pre-IPO legal due diligence**: Qwen4-Max demonstrates exceptional ability to handle complex, long-horizon legal work. Faced with 198 inconsistently formatted and named working papers supplied by the client in batches, the model effectively filters out noise, **renames and categorizes the files by substantive content** into 14 folders, and automatically compiles a working paper index. It also proactively searches public records covering business registration, intellectual property, judicial records and credit records, **cross-checking these sources** against the working papers to verify facts concerning the issuer. For core risk control, the model **scrutinizes contractual provisions and analyzes legal risks**, accurately identifying potential concerns such as reinstatement clauses in valuation adjustment mechanism (VAM) agreements and providing actionable remedial recommendations. Ultimately, it delivers a comprehensive report meeting rigorous professional standards: **86 pages, over 60,000 Chinese characters**, 12 review areas including corporate history and shareholding structure, and 14 specific legal issues. **Every conclusion is backed by working paper citations** for full traceability, drastically boosting efficiency and empowering legal counsel to focus on core risk judgments.

Frequent diagnostic testing generates a massive volume of heterogeneous medical data—dozens of lab reports, over 10,000 Chinese characters of progress notes, multiple sets of physician orders, and 1,433 original medical images. The patient in this video developed ventricular fibrillation after carotid artery stenting and was successfully resuscitated, only to experience chest pain post-extubation and require reintubation on Day 6. Within a single conversation, Qwen4 reviews the entire complex medical record, completing an end-to-end workflow from information extraction to clinical decision support: **querying lab values** (accurately locating specific CRP results across multiple dates), **structuring the clinical course** (aligning six days of complex events into a coherent timeline), **interpreting imaging** (categorizing studies into six imaging series, pinpointing the target chest CT, and deploying multiple subagents to simultaneously review hundreds of original slices to identify bilateral dependent consolidation, fully consistent with the attending physician’s diagnosis), and **supporting decisions** (synthesizing multimodal clinical evidence to propose four management recommendations that correspond point by point with the physician’s actual orders that day). Through close integration into the clinical workflow, the model efficiently consolidates evidence from multiple sources to provide reliable, actionable support for frontline clinical decision-making.

2026-11-19 05:20:07 JST [akira/akira/849a8348e5794d4783596384ea09800e] ./notes/build-2026-10-29-b.py:16:<article class="tl-item dot-other" id="qwen-4-training"><div class="tl-card"><div class="tl-date">2026-09-22 <span class="tl-provider-tag" style="background:rgba(203,213,225,.15);color:#cbd5e1;">Alibaba</span></div><h2 class="tl-title">Qwen 4（Alibaba）— 公式は「学習中」、時期・料金・ベンチマークは未公表</h2><p class="tl-desc">ApsaraカンファレンスでAlibabaが次世代モデル<strong>Qwen 4が「currently in training（学習中）」</strong>と公式に表明。会場では Qwen4 Max / Flash / Plus / 27B の4階層名が示された<strong>との報道</strong>がありますが、公式の文書には仕様・料金・ベンチマークの記載がありません。<strong>「10月末リリース予定」は公式に記載がなく、報道・コミュニティの推測</strong>です。当サイトは公式に数値が出るまで掲載しません。<span class="tl-price-badge">料金未確認</span></p><div class="tl-links"><a href="/china-ai/#labs-h">中国AI総覧 →</a><a href="/pricing/">料金比較 →</a></div></div></article>
2026-11-19 05:20:07 JST [akira/akira/849a8348e5794d4783596384ea09800e] ./notes/build-2026-10-29-b.py:21:<article class="tl-item dot-other" id="kimi-k3-1-pro"><div class="tl-card"><div class="tl-date">2026-10-23 <span class="tl-provider-tag" style="background:rgba(203,213,225,.15);color:#cbd5e1;">Moonshot</span></div><h2 class="tl-title">Kimi K3.1 Pro series rolls out — 3T-class, 1M context <span class="badge badge-new" style="font-size:.7rem;">New</span></h2><p class="tl-desc">First model in the new K3.1 series. In Kimi's own words, "our most capable 3T-class model to date", with a 1M-token context and stronger coding, 3D creation, financial research and long-horizon agent work. <strong>K3.1 Pro Highspeed</strong> ships alongside it at roughly 2-3x the speed with the same quality (K3.1 Pro on Plus/Moderato and above; Pro/Allegretto and above unlock up to 1M context; Highspeed on Pro/Allegretto and above). Thinking mode only: low/high/max, default high. <span class="tl-price-badge">API pricing not stated on that page — unconfirmed</span></p><div class="tl-links"><a href="https://www.kimi.com/code/docs/en/kimi-code/whats-new.html" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Official What's New →</a><a href="/en/china-ai/#labs-h">China AI overview →</a></div></div></article>
2026-11-19 05:20:07 JST [akira/akira/849a8348e5794d4783596384ea09800e] ./notes/build-2026-10-29-b.py:22:<article class="tl-item dot-other" id="qwen-4-training"><div class="tl-card"><div class="tl-date">2026-09-22 <span class="tl-provider-tag" style="background:rgba(203,213,225,.15);color:#cbd5e1;">Alibaba</span></div><h2 class="tl-title">Qwen 4 (Alibaba) — officially "in training"; no date, price or benchmarks published</h2><p class="tl-desc">At its Apsara conference Alibaba confirmed that its next-generation model <strong>Qwen 4 is "currently in training"</strong>. The four-tier lineup (Qwen4 Max / Flash / Plus / 27B) was shown on stage according to <strong>press reports</strong>, but no official document lists specs, prices or benchmarks. <strong>The "end of October" release window is not in any official statement</strong> — it is press and community speculation. We publish no numbers until Alibaba does. <span class="tl-price-badge">Pricing unconfirmed</span></p><div class="tl-links"><a href="/en/china-ai/#labs-h">China AI overview →</a><a href="/en/pricing/">Pricing →</a></div></div></article>

2026-11-19 05:25:27 JST [akira/akira/849a8348e5794d4783596384ea09800e] 81:<p>Alibabaのオープンウェイト・モデルファミリー。フラッグシップ Qwen3.8-Max（2026-08-03 GA）は2.4TパラメータMoE・1Mコンテキスト。低コストの Qwen3.8-Flash（2026-08-26）は125B/6B active MoEでQwen4アーキテクチャのプレビュー（オープンウェイト版Flash-NextはHF/ModelScopeで公開。ライセンス条件は各モデルカードで未確認）。<a href="/qwen-3-8-flash/">Qwen3.8-Flash詳細</a>。</p><p><strong>Qwen4-Max</strong>（2026-11-15公開・現行フラッグシップ）は1Mトークンコンテキスト（最大入力991K・通常出力131K／thinking時262K）で text/image/video 入力に対応します。QwenCloud（Alibaba Cloud Model Studio）の公式料金は<strong>入力$1.50／出力$4.50／暗黙キャッシュ$0.075</strong>（1Mトークン）、明示キャッシュの作成は5分TTL $1.875・1時間TTL $3.00。11-11からToken Plan限定で先行提供されていた <code>qwen4-max-preview</code> に続き、11-15に単価が公表されて正式提供に移行しました。ベンチマーク・重みの公開状況は当サイトでは未確認です。<a href="/pricing/#qwen-h">料金表</a>。</p></div>

2026-11-19 05:25:27 JST [akira/akira/849a8348e5794d4783596384ea09800e] 80:<p>Alibaba's open-weight family. Flagship Qwen3.8-Max (GA 2026-08-03) is a 2.4T-parameter MoE with 1M context. Low-cost Qwen3.8-Flash (2026-08-26) is a 125B/6B active MoE previewing the Qwen4 architecture (open-weight Flash-Next on HF/ModelScope; check each model card for license terms). <a href="/en/qwen-3-8-flash/">Qwen3.8-Flash details</a>.</p><p><strong>Qwen4-Max</strong> (released 2026-11-15, now the flagship) offers a 1M-token context (up to 991K input; 131K output, or 262K when thinking) with text, image and video input. Official QwenCloud (Alibaba Cloud Model Studio) pricing is <strong>$1.50 input / $4.50 output / $0.075 implicit cache</strong> per 1M tokens, with explicit cache writes at $1.875 (5 min TTL) and $3.00 (1 hour TTL). It follows the Token Plan-only preview (<code>qwen4-max-preview</code>, from 11-11) and moved to general availability with published unit prices on 11-15. Benchmarks and weight availability are unconfirmed here. <a href="/en/pricing/#qwen-h">Pricing</a>.</p></div>
2026-11-19 05:25:27 JST [akira/akira/849a8348e5794d4783596384ea09800e] 83:  <div class="lab-card"><span class="lab-tag">StepFun</span><h3>StepFun (阶跃星辰)</h3><p>A Chinese AI startup. Its official documentation splits pricing by model category, and one of those categories is <strong>&ldquo;Multimodal Reasoning Models&rdquo;</strong>, where as of 2026-10-13 it lists <strong>step-5-preview</strong> ($1.00 / $2.70) and <strong>step-3.7-flash</strong> ($0.20 / $1.15), with cached input at $0.10 and $0.04 respectively. The wider catalogue spans text-only, vision, speech and image generation &mdash; for speech, stepaudio-2.5-realtime ($1.50/$10.00) and step-audio-r1.5 ($1.43/$15.00), among others. <a href="#stepfun-h">See the pricing split</a>.</p></div>
